remarks: Enjoy effortless living in this sun-filled one-bedroom, one-bath condo, perfectly situated in a beautifully maintained community in the heart of Stamford, offering a blend of timeless character and modern comfort. The thoughtfully designed layout features generous living and dining areas, gleaming hardwood floors, oversized windows, and high ceilings that create an open, airy feel throughout. The updated kitchen includes granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, while the spacious bedroom provides excellent closet space for easy living. Residents enjoy beautifully landscaped grounds, on-site laundry, additional storage, bike storage, and convenient off-street parking. Ideally located and just minutes from downtown shopping, dining, parks, and Metro-North, this home offers charm, convenience, and a commuter-friendly lifestyle. An excellent opportunity for both homeowners and investors alike, this unit can also be rented, making it a great option as an income-producing property or a smart addition to any real estate portfolio.
